TASHKENTSPIRE2-EJECTION_START.title: Ejection Start
TASHKENTSPIRE2-EJECTION_START.descriptio: At the start of your turn, [gold]Charge[/gold] [blue]1[/blue]; at the end of your turn, [gold]Retreat[/gold] [blue]1[/blue].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ENGINE_BOOST.title: Engine Boost
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ENGINE_BOOST.flavor: 'Full speed toward the horizon! Don't worry, the propulsion system hasn't reached its limit yet!'
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ENGINE_BOOST.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Charge[/gold] [blue]3[/blue]; at the end of your turn, [gold]Retreat[/gold] [blue]3[/blue].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-LOADING_DEVICE.title: Loading Device
TASHKENTSPIRE2-LOADING_DEVICE.flavor: Even the most experienced gunner would be amazed by the efficiency of this automatic loader.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-LOADING_DEVICE.descriptio:
You may now [gold]Load[/gold] [blue]6[/blue] onto an [gold]Ammo[/gold] card at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
Choosing the Load option first does not consume a Rest Site action.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ORDER_OF_SOLIDARITY.title: Order of Solidarity
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ORDER_OF_SOLIDARITY.flavo: Glory belongs not to individuals, but to comrades who advance and retreat together.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ORDER_OF_SOLIDARITY.descr: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with: [purple]Solidarity[/purple].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SCOPE.title: Scope
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SCOPE.flavor: Lock on, fine-tune, then... wait for the decisive moment.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SCOPE.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Mark[/gold] to an enemy, apply an additional [blue]{TashkentSpire2-Mark:diff()}[/blue] stack(s).
TASHKENTSPIRE2-INTELLIGENCE_DOCUMENT.fla: Know yourself and know your enemy, and the battle is already half won before the first shot.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-INTELLIGENCE_DOCUMENT.des: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{TashkentSpire2-Mark:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Mark[/gold] to all enemies.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-THRUSTER.title: Thruster
TASHKENTSPIRE2-THRUSTER.flavor: This improved ignition device lets torpedoes reach cruising speed the instant they leave the tube.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-THRUSTER.description: Your [gold]Torpedoes[/gold] activate [blue]1[/blue] turn earlier when created.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-WILL_TO_WIN.title: Will to Win
TASHKENTSPIRE2-WILL_TO_WIN.flavor: The instinct to survive in desperate moments is often sharper than any blade.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-WILL_TO_WIN.description:
The FIRST time each combat you would take [red]fatal damage[/red], or lose [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold] instead, prevent death, and restore HP to [blue]1[/blue].
While at exactly [blue]1[/blue] HP, gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to [blue]20[/blue]% of damage dealt by cards.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-FUEL.title: Fuel
TASHKENTSPIRE2-FUEL.flavor: Burn every resource to its fullest and turn it into the force that breaks through enemy lines.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TORPEDO_RECOIL_DEVICE.des: After launching your first [gold]Torpedo[/gold] each turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ABSOLUT_VODKA.title: Absolut Vodka
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ABSOLUT_VODKA.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with: [purple]Fermentation[/purple].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_UNION.title: Unbreakable Union
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_UNION.flavor: The Union may borrow from today, but it never abandons tomorrow.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_UNION.descriptio:
At the start of each turn, [red]lose[/red] {Energy:energyIcons()}; excess Energy is retained until next turn.
Whenever you play a card, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, but after each [gold]Shuffle[/gold], all cards cost an additional [blue]1[/blue] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-PREFERRED_PLAN.title: Preferred Plan
TASHKENTSPIRE2-PREFERRED_PLAN.flavor: The most important tasks deserve to be arranged in advance.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-PREFERRED_PLAN.descriptio: At the start of each turn, a random highest-cost card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] costs {Energy:energyIcons()} less this turn.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SHORT_TERM_DAMAGE_CONTROL: Patch today's breach with tomorrow's steel plates.

At the start of combat, gain {MaxHp:diff()} [gold]Max HP[/gold].
At the start of each turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-COMMISSAR_HAT.title: Commissar's Hat
TASHKENTSPIRE2-COMMISSAR_HAT.flavor: Sometimes conviction weighs more than orders.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-COMMISSAR_HAT.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with: [purple]Commissar[/purple].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-THE_LAST_SHELL.title: The Last Shell!
TASHKENTSPIRE2-THE_LAST_SHELL.flavor: Before falling, save the last round for the enemy!
TASHKENTSPIRE2-THE_LAST_SHELL.descriptio: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attack or Skill card(s) from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with: [purple]Exhaust[/purple].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-BEAR_CLAW_GLOVES.title: Bear Claw Gloves
TASHKENTSPIRE2-BEAR_CLAW_GLOVES.flavor: A gift from a young girl.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-BEAR_CLAW_GLOVES.descript: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card(s) into [gold]Charged Strike[/gold].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ARCTIC_HARE.title: Arctic Hare?
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ARCTIC_HARE.flavor: Such an adorable little bunny. How dangerous could it possibly be?
TASHKENTSPIRE2-ARCTIC_HARE.description: At the start of your turn, gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-K_G_B.title: KGB Techniques
TASHKENTSPIRE2-K_G_B.flavor: Learn from others to surpass them.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-K_G_B.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Espionage Warfare[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
